name: Iridescence-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Wide pink, mint and lilac bands stretch across the full frame with the clearest wave shapes.

tagline: Silky pink, mint and lilac waves roll like soap film.
summary: A full-bleed surface of smooth iridescent bands in pastel pink, mint, lavender and white. The bands slide and fold continuously, and the pointer nudges the whole pattern sideways.
appearance: Soft, glossy bands in bubblegum pink, pale mint, lilac and bright white sweep across the frame in long folds. Colour shifts gradually within each band, with a pearly sheen and no visible grain.
behaviour: The folds move and reshape at an even pace, like oil on water, without ever settling. Moving the pointer displaces the whole pattern in its direction, adding a slight drag to the flow.
search_phrases: light pink and mint wave background
use_when: A bright, colour-rich backdrop should carry a hero without any readable content of its own.
avoid_when: Dark themes or dark text: the shader is built on white and pastel tones throughout.
customise: A tint colour, speed, pointer amplitude and whether the pointer reacts at all are the only props. The wave pattern itself is fixed in the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen shader loops a per-pixel fold calculation every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative only and no reduced-motion check, so the flowing bands never stop for motion-sensitive users.

polish_why: A rich, distinctive iridescent look; it stays so bright that white text is hard to place.
title: Iridescence
